from collections import defaultdict
# events in window
evs = [e for e in events if start <= e[2] <= end]
node_events = defaultdict(list)
for (u,v,t) in evs:
    node_events[u].append((u,v,t))
    node_events[v].append((u,v,t))

print('Events in window:', len(evs))
# counts per node
print('\nCounts per node:')
for n in nodes:
    print(n, len(node_events[n]))

# Undirected direct interactions among nodes (pairs) within window
pairs_direct = []
for (u,v,t) in evs:
    if u in nodes and v in nodes:
        pairs_direct.append((u,v,t))
print('\nDirect interactions among the node set in window:', len(pairs_direct))
for p in pairs_direct:
    print(p)

# Find shared neighbor supports
supports = []
for i_idx,i in enumerate(nodes):
    for j in nodes[i_idx+1:]:
        # gather interactions of i and j with any r
        li = node_events[i]
        lj = node_events[j]
        for (u1,v1,t1) in li:
            r1 = v1 if u1==i else u1
            for (u2,v2,t2) in lj:
                r2 = v2 if u2==j else u2
                if r1==r2:
                    supports.append({'i':i,'j':j,'r':r1,'t_i':t1,'t_j':t2})

print('\nSupports found (both interacted with same r) in window:', len(supports))
# For each support, check any closing interaction between i and j in window and its timing relative to max(t_i,t_j)
closures = []
for s in supports:
    i,j,r,t_i,t_j = s['i'],s['j'],s['r'],s['t_i'],s['t_j']
    t_support = max(t_i,t_j)
    # find closings in window
    closings = [t for (u,v,t) in evs if set((u,v))==set((i,j))]
    if closings:
        for t_close in closings:
            closures.append({'i':i,'j':j,'r':r,'t_support':t_support,'t_close':t_close,'delay':t_close-t_support})
    else:
        closures.append({'i':i,'j':j,'r':r,'t_support':t_support,'t_close':None,'delay':None})

# Print unique supports with closure info
seen = set()
uniq = []
for c in closures:
    key=(c['i'],c['j'],c['r'])
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    uniq.append(c)

print('\nUnique (i,j,r) supports with closure info:', len(uniq))
for c in uniq:
    print(c)

# Also show any closings among node pairs regardless of support
print('\nAny direct closings among node pairs in window (pairs among nodes list):')
direct_pairs = {}
for (u,v,t) in evs:
    if u in nodes and v in nodes:
        key = tuple(sorted((u,v)))
        direct_pairs.setdefault(key,[]).append(t)
for k in sorted(direct_pairs):
    print(k, direct_pairs[k])

# Also show any shared neighbor interactions where support times exist but closing occurs after >800 within window
late_closures = [c for c in uniq if c['t_close'] is not None and c['delay']>800]
print('\nLate closures (>800):', len(late_closures))
for c in late_closures:
    print(c)

# Also check supports where closing happens before support (i.e., not following):
closing_before = [c for c in uniq if c['t_close'] is not None and c['t_close']<c['t_support']]
print('\nClosings that occur before support (not valid):', len(closing_before))
for c in closing_before:
    print(c)
